groups.defect: Legacy Update recomputes the object through raw objInfo instead of persisting the unified-storage result, repeats potentially non-idempotent callbacks, and can apply asynchronous updates out of order.
groups.rationale: All three report removal of the result-pinning wrapper. s_4d3c3dc5 additionally reports write reordering, which must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: Mode 3 mutation tests do not await and independently assert legacy writes, allowing the legacy half of dual writing to disappear without failing tests.
groups.rationale: The first suggestion covers all mutation tests, including the Delete and DeleteCollection omissions described by the second. Each affected test needs synchronization and meaningful legacy assertions.

groups.defect: Delete installs the unenriched logger in its context and labels successful duration metrics with the object name instead of kind, losing log context and exposing high-cardinality object identifiers.
groups.rationale: s_6b11a209 explicitly reports both defects and connects the logger-only and metric-only suggestions. Both local corrections must remain in the merged comment.

groups.defect: All four asynchronous legacy mutation paths inherit request cancellation and omit failure logging, allowing legacy writes to be aborted without a diagnostic log.
groups.rationale: Each suggestion identifies the same request-context lifetime mistake across Create, Delete, Update, and DeleteCollection. Consolidation must retain the affected paths and missing failure diagnostics.

groups.defect: Delete returns on unified-storage NotFound before attempting legacy deletion, leaving legacy-only objects behind.
groups.rationale: Both identify the removed NotFound fall-through and require the same control-flow correction.

groups.defect: Duration recording uses the wrong backend helper for unified-storage Create and Update failures and for the legacy DeleteCollection operation.
groups.rationale: These are repeated backend-attribution mistakes in metric calls. The merged comment must cover all three call sites, including the inverse helper mix-up in DeleteCollection.
